invariants.name: RejectedAttemptDoesNotChangeCanonicalState
invariants.statement: A rejected, failed, canon-rejected, permit-rejected, or quarantined attempt shall not change the canonical Context state or root.

invariants.name: AttemptReferencesExactParent
invariants.statement: Every attempt shall reference the exact canonical parent Context root from which execution was requested.

invariants.name: AttemptUsesExactPermit
invariants.statement: Every attempt shall reference the exact Permit evaluated for that attempt; a rejected Permit does not authorize execution.

invariants.name: NegativeDispositionIsTerminal
invariants.statement: A negative disposition is terminal for that attempt and shall have no successor execution transition.

invariants.name: QuarantinedCandidateCannotBeParent
invariants.statement: A quarantined or rejected candidate shall never become the parent of a later canonical transition or retry.

invariants.name: VerificationDoesNotEqualRecognition
invariants.statement: Monade verification or acceptance for recognition shall not itself recognize an Outcome or change canonical Context.

invariants.name: AttemptRecordIsAppendOnly
invariants.statement: Attempt evidence and dispositions are append-only; corrections are represented by new records and explicit references.

invariants.name: RetryCreatesNewAttempt
invariants.statement: A retry shall use a new attempt identifier and shall reference, but never overwrite or continue from, the previous attempt.

invariants.name: EvidenceReferencesAreContentAddressed
invariants.statement: Evidence references carried by the profile shall use content-addressed digests.

invariants.name: MasterProjectionIsReadOnly
invariants.statement: Projection of attempt evidence to Master as LearningObservation is read-only and grants no Permit, authority, verification, or Outcome recognition.
